_comment: One place for what testers read on each build: TestFlight's What to Test (tool/testflight.py) and Play's release notes (tool/play_upload.py). Change it with the version in pubspec.yaml; a build whose version is not this one says so in its notes instead of repeating an old release's.
what_to_test: 1. Members' card by NFC: open Customers > Scan or tap their card (or a loyalty or discount step on the till) and hold an Android phone or Wear OS watch with a Loughor RFC members' app, unlocked, near the back of this phone or tablet: the member is found as if their QR were scanned. 2. Plastic member cards, staff cards and key fobs still read as before. 3. A locked phone or one not signed in to the members' app is not read: unlock it and try again. 4. The QR code and typing the code still work everywhere.
release_notes: Tap a member's phone or watch to find them: Vesopa Go now reads the members' card from Android phones and Wear OS watches held near the reader (NFC), as well as plastic cards, fobs and QR codes.
